name: Distress Call
text: A stranded freighter calls for help. Its crew offers what it can.
speaker: stranded_crew

choices.text: Give them fuel. They give you a ship part.

reply.text: Thank you, pilot. Take this part. It still works.

choices.text: Carry their supplies to the next station.

reply.text: Our supplies are in your hands now. Fly safe.
We understand. Somebody else will come. Maybe.
